meta.face: A Briton of about seventy, lean and weathered by the sea wind, with a fair, ruddy complexion and a BROAD, UPRIGHT RECTANGULAR face whose most striking feature is a HEAVY, OVERHANGING BROW RIDGE — small, bright, sea-grey eyes set DEEP in its shadow, thick, straight white brows, a SHORT, BROAD nose with a FLAT bridge, wide, high cheekbones over lean cheeks, a broad, straight, thin-lipped mouth open a little as he speaks, a firm, SQUARE chin; the front of the head shaved back to a line from ear to ear in the old insular monk's tonsure, the white hair behind it falling straight to the collar; a SHORT, close-cropped white beard following the square jaw; the gaze fiery and direct, out over the crowd.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The book tells the ground rising under him as he preached at Brefi; Wikipedia adds the white dove that settled on his shoulder there, his emblem, and that he is usually shown standing on a hill with the dove. The heavy brow, the flat short nose and the insular tonsure (ear to ear; its exact shape is uncertain, per Wikipedia) are our choice, to keep him from the set's other white-bearded elders.
